raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.13.3"

recipe:
  name: libgdal-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: http://download.osgeo.org/gdal/${{ version }}/gdal-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: a3348c2102dd91962290007d7c293b467bb1b0cd89f086f24bb97b9b653a9804
  patches:
    - if: osx
      then: 000_cmake.patch
    # Below is a hack that will eventually break.
    - CMP0190_disable.patch
    # Backport kealib 2.0 patch - will be removed when GDAL 3.14 is released
    - kealib20.patch

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: core-build
    build:
      script:
        file: build_core
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - if: not win
          then: pkg-config >=0.21
        - ninja
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - swig
      host:
        - blosc
        - expat
        - geos
        # We use internal libtiff and libgeotiff for JXL-in-TIFF support
        # - geotiff
        - if: not win
          then: giflib
        - libjpeg-turbo
        - if: not win
          then: json-c
        - lerc
        - libarchive
        - libcurl
        - libdeflate
        - libiconv
        - libjxl
        - libkml-devel
        - liblzma-devel
        - libpng
        - libspatialite
        # We use internal libtiff and libgeotiff for JXL-in-TIFF support
        # - libtiff
        - libwebp-base
        - libxml2-devel
        - lz4-c
        - muparser
        - openssl
        - pcre2
        - proj
        # qhull disabled because of https://github.com/conda-forge/qgis-feedstock/issues/284#issuecomment-1356490896
        # - qhull
        - sqlite
        - xerces-c
        - zlib
        - zstd
        # For these plugins, we need the headers for the core sources
        - kealib
        - highfive
        - openjpeg
        - tiledb
        - libnetcdf
        - libheif
        - if: not win
          then: libadbc-driver-manager
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - kealib
          - openjpeg
          - tiledb
          - libnetcdf
          - libheif
          - if: not win
            then: libadbc-driver-manager

  - package:
      name: libgdal-core
    inherit: core-build
    build:
      python:
        skip_pyc_compilation:
          - share/bash-completion/completions/*.py
    requirements:
      # TODO: Remove the build and host sections when rattler-build is fixed
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libgdal-core', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - libgdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - gdalinfo --help

  - package:
      name: libgdal-core-devel
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libgdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - expat
        - libkml-devel
        - liblzma-devel
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - gdalinfo --help

  - package:
      name: libgdal-arrow-parquet
    inherit: core-build
    build:
      script:
        file: build_plugin
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: not win
          then: pkg-config
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libgdal-core-devel', exact=True) }}
        - libarrow
        - libarrow-dataset
        - libparquet
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libgdal-core', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/gdalplugins/ogr_Arrow${SHLIB_EXT}
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/gdalplugins/ogr_Parquet${SHLIB_EXT}
              else:
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\gdalplugins\ogr_Arrow.dll exit 1
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\gdalplugins\ogr_Parquet.dll exit 1
            - gdalinfo --format Arrow
            - gdalinfo --format Parquet
    about:
      summary: Arrow and Parquet drivers for the Geospatial Data Abstraction Library (GDAL)
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE.TXT

  - package:
      name: libgdal-jp2openjpeg
    inherit: core-build
    build:
      script:
        env:
          GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: JP2OpenJPEG
          GDAL_PLUGIN_TYPE: gdal
          GDAL_PLUGIN_DEPS: "-DGDAL_USE_OPENJPEG=ON"
        file: build_plugin
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake

        - openjpeg
      run:

    tests:
      - script:
          env:
            GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: JP2OpenJPEG
            GDAL_PLUGIN_TYPE: gdal
            GDAL_PLUGIN_DEPS: "-DGDAL_USE_OPENJPEG=ON"
          content:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/gdalplugins/${GDAL_PLUGIN_TYPE}_${GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME}${SHLIB_EXT}
                - gdalinfo --format ${GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME}
              else:
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\gdalplugins\%GDAL_PLUGIN_TYPE%_%GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME%.dll exit 1
                - gdalinfo --format %GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME%
    about:

    tests:

        script:
          env:

              else:
                - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\gdalplugins\%GDAL_PLUGIN_TYPE%_%GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME%.dll exit 1
                - gdalinfo --format %GDAL_PLUGIN_NAME%
                - test_pdf.bat
